verses.text: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. All [you] peoples, clap your hands; shout unto God, with a voice of a ringing cry!

segments.text: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. All [you] peoples, clap your hands; shout unto God, with a voice of a ringing cry!

verses.text: For YHWH-Elyon [is] to be feared; [He is] the great King over all the earth.

segments.text: For YHWH-Elyon [is] to be feared; [He is] the great King over all the earth.

verses.text: He turns back the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.

segments.text: He turns back the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.

verses.text: He chose for us our inheritance, the excellence of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah

segments.text: He chose for us our inheritance, the excellence of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah

verses.text: God has gone up with a shout, YHWH with the voice of a shofar.

segments.text: God has gone up with a shout, YHWH with the voice of a shofar.

verses.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!

segments.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!

verses.text: For the King of all the earth [is] God—sing praises [with] skill!

segments.text: For the King of all the earth [is] God—sing praises [with] skill!

verses.text: God reigns over the nations; God sits upon the throne of His holiness.

segments.text: God reigns over the nations; God sits upon the throne of His holiness.

verses.text: The princes of the peoples have gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth [are] unto God—[He is] greatly to be exalted.

segments.text: The princes of the peoples have gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth [are] unto God—[He is] greatly to be exalted.
